#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    // Replace multiple underscores with a single space
    string t;
    bool lastUnderscore = false;
    for (char ch : s) {
        if (ch == '_') {
            if (!lastUnderscore) {
                t += ' ';
                lastUnderscore = true;
            }
        } else {
            t += ch;
            lastUnderscore = false;
        }
    }

    // Insert spaces around parentheses
    string u;
    for (char ch : t) {
        if (ch == '(') {
            u += " ( ";
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            u += " ) ";
        } else {
            u += ch;
        }
    }

    // Split by spaces
    istringstream iss(u);
    string token;
    bool inside = false;
    int maxLen = 0, count = 0;

    while (iss >> token) {
        if (token == "(") {
            inside = true;
        } else if (token == ")") {
            inside = false;
        } else {
            if (inside) {
                count++;
            } else {
                maxLen = max(maxLen, (int)token.length());
            }
        }
    }

    cout << maxLen << " " << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
